# Franklin Pediatric Dentistry

> Board-certified pediatric dentistry practice led by Dr. John Eric Yezerski, DMD, providing specialized dental care for children in Franklin, Tennessee.

Franklin Pediatric Dentistry is a dedicated pediatric dental practice offering comprehensive oral health services for infants, children, and adolescents. Dr. Yezerski is board-certified by the American Board of Pediatric Dentistry and holds memberships in the American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry, bringing expertise from training at prestigious institutions including the University of Kentucky College of Dentistry.

## Dental Care Guides

- [Dental Care for Babies](https://www.franklinpediatricdentistry.com/dental-care-for-babies.html): Educational guide on infant dental care, teething, and cavity prevention
- [Brushing and Flossing Tips for Children](https://www.franklinpediatricdentistry.com/brushing-and-flossing-tips-for-children.html): Guide on proper brushing and flossing techniques for children's oral hygiene
- [Thumb Sucking](https://www.franklinpediatricdentistry.com/thumb-sucking.html): Parenting guide addressing thumb sucking habits and orthodontic prevention
